title: Split a port's maintenance budget and read the answer
heading: GLOP Solves It: Read the Status, Then the Amounts, Then the Rows
cases: an allowed budget returns OPTIMAL, the best value, the amounts and the full rows
amounts are continuous, so a budget of 600.5 is split to the fraction
floors that no split can meet give INFEASIBLE with no value, amounts or rows
a floor is a least amount, so a terminal worth less still gets its floor
a row is full when its activity sits on either bound, the lower one included
no amount is negative, even when moving money from a poor terminal would pay
